name: Zippy Spaghetti Sauce
description: A flavorful and spicy spaghetti sauce with sausage, hamburger, and taco seasoning.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the hamburger and chopped onion.
Add garlic, oregano, salt, pepper, and taco seasoning.
Chop the summer sausage into 1/4 inch pieces and add to the mixture.
Add the Ragu spaghetti sauce and drained mushrooms.
Simmer for 10 minutes.

keywords: spaghetti sauce, zippy sauce, sausage, taco seasoning

_similar.name: Baked Spaghetti and Meatballs
_similar.description: A hearty baked pasta dish featuring meatballs, spaghetti, and a rich tomato-based sauce topped with melted mozzarella cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and start boiling water for cooking spaghetti.
In a large bowl, mix ground beef, chopped onion, egg, Worcestershire sauce, and black pepper. Form into meatballs.
Fry the meatballs in a skillet until completely cooked, turning gently with tongs. Drain off excess fat.
Add spaghetti sauce, diced tomatoes, mushrooms, green pepper, and oregano to the skillet. Simmer for approximately 15 minutes.
Cook spaghetti until 'al dente', then rinse and drain.
Combine cooked spaghetti with sour cream.
Pour the spaghetti mixture into a greased 6-cup casserole dish. Sprinkle with half of the shredded mozzarella cheese.
Cover with the sauce and meatball mixture. Bake, uncovered, at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and bake for an additional 5 to 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

_similar.name: Spaghetti Casserole
_similar.description: A hearty spaghetti casserole with ground beef, canned tomatoes, and cheddar cheese.
recipeIngredient: 1 can (10 oz) condensed cream of mushroom soup

recipeInstructions.text: Brown the ground beef and onion in a frying pan.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions.
Transfer cooked spaghetti to a 2-quart casserole dish.
Pour canned tomatoes over the spaghetti layer.
Spoon the browned meat mixture over the tomatoes.
Cover with cream of mushroom soup.
Cover with grated cheddar cheese.
Bake at 350°F for 30 minutes, uncovered, until cheese starts to get bubbly.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti casserole, ground beef, cheddar cheese

_similar.name: Mozzarella Spaghetti Skillet
_similar.description: A one-pot spaghetti dish cooked with hamburger, tomatoes, and mozzarella cheese.
recipeIngredient: Broken spaghetti to feed your family

recipeInstructions.text: In an electric skillet, brown the hamburger, onion, and green peppers.
Season with Worcestershire sauce, salt, black pepper, and oregano.
Add tomatoes, water, and broken spaghetti to the skillet.
Cover and bring to a boil, stirring frequently to prevent the spaghetti from sticking.
Simmer until the pasta is cooked.
Shortly before serving, add shredded mozzarella cheese and continue heating until melted.

_similar.keywords: spaghetti skillet, one-pot pasta, mozzarella cheese
